gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: The players are gearing ___ for the final.
gaps.explanation: gear up for = prepare for a big event.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.
